decisionTitle: Keep the compatible writer-off artifact as the format rollback boundary
decision: RANGE_RECEIVE selects framing of newly fetched live pages. The compatible reader keeps the binary reader and authenticated monotonic floor. Prove actual stale-tab/mixed-row/cold behavior and minimal container runtime separately, bind them to exact source/image bytes and retain local archives. Flag rollback/history reduction does not remove the floor or make pre-release clients compatible. Once the floor commits, rollback requires this compatible reader; pre-release builds lock out dense-writing devices. These are hardening artifacts only.
